title: wb task clean cannot prune more than one ticket at a time
desc:
Cleaning up a checkout means naming every finished ticket by hand. The two selectors worth having were cut from WB-15 deliberately and named in .workflow/idea-dashboard/frame.md as the full version.

Also: cli/task.py opens with 'Two commands, deliberately unequal' and now registers five actions. Prose has no CI, so it drifted.

ACCEPTANCE:
- --merged selects every ticket whose branch is gone from the remote
- --older-than <n>d selects by last modification
- both list first; --force is still required to remove
- a selector that matches nothing says so and exits 0
- cleaning a ticket whose work is unfinished says which stage it is at, in the listing
- the module docstring describes the actions that exist
